* **Tabata Squat**: 20 seconds work / 10 seconds rest for 8 intervals
* **Muscle-ups**: Max reps in 4 minutes (starting immediately after the last Tabata rest)
section_notes: Tabata score is the lowest number of reps in any of the 8 intervals.
Total score = Tabata score x total muscle-ups.

Test score equals Tabata score multiplied by number of muscle-ups completed. Post score to comments. Compare to 131009.
